steps.content: The only person in the quiet salon is the hairdresser herself. She's washing her hands, as if she had just finished a long, busy day.

How many people's "worries" did those hands sever? In other words, how many cherished relationships did those hands break off? Only God knows. Her face is still so calm and tranquil as she looks at you.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...I didn't expect you to come find me on your own. And still looking so disheveled.
Those coldly gleaming shears have been put aside. You shift your gaze and look back into her eyes.

options: Do I actually look that bad?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Yeah. You're full of worries, and your hair is so long.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Want me to give you a trim?

options: Before that, I'd like a more basic service.

steps.content: You ruffle your bangs.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I messed up my hair again. Can I ask <color=#fb9259>hairdresser</color> Adela to fix it for me?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...Of course. Whatever you need.
She smiles and pulls back the barber chair. You saunter up to it and sit down quietly.
Like some unspoken ritual, the two of you return to this spot, intimate yet wary.
It's as if you're a regular customer of hers.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Like you always do.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: What do you want to chat about?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'll listen to whatever you want to tell me. Just like what you did for me before.
The corners of her mouth twitch, as if she wants to give you a smile, but in the end she doesn't. After pondering for a moment, Adela speaks up again.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...I don't have anything in particular that I want to talk about. I'll just pick a topic that you would be interested in.

steps.speaker: And Miss Campbell, she's gone too...
steps.content: ...It's about the story of <color=#fb9259>"Mad Shears"</color>.

Her fingers brush behind your ears as she gently fixes your hair. The shears return to that intimate distance. One snip after another, your hair tips fly amidst the gleams again, but this time, you don't shudder.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: A long time ago, there was a lucky little girl who didn't have any worries. She lived a peaceful life and liked it very much. She thought everyone was like her.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: But that wasn't the case. Life was not good for everyone, and slowly, the people she loved sprouted long, long hair. Hair that could not be cut off. Hair that suffocated the soul.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Everyone lived in pain, and could only vent their discontent through words.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: The girl wanted to help. She listened to them, took care of them, and did all that she could. Sometimes, their symptoms could be soothed by a cup of black tea, and other times by tears. But ultimately, there was no cure.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: The girl finally realized she could do so little. Those were other people's worries, which they can't let go of so long as they remember them.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: So the girl prayed to gain the power to help people forget, and was bestowed a pair of <color=#fb9259>magical shears</color>.

steps.speaker: She just ran down there... Damn it! Hella? Hella, where are you?!
steps.content: Worrisome hairs are condensed and severed with each cut, vanishing forever into the ether. The people she loved no longer wallowed in resentment. They forgot everything that worried them, and regained their joyful smiles.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: The girl's wish came true. She thanked the magical shears, and vowed to protect everyone forever.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...That's the story of Mad Shears. Everyone lived happily ever after.
The shears halt. She gently brushes aside your fallen hair, and locks eyes with you in the mirror.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: All finished. How do you like this haircut?

options: Thank you, I like it very much.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I look exactly the same as the old me.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: You remember now? Then do you remember what you said to me on that first night?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I remember.
That night, in the depths of the foggy alley, you watched her walk up to you. The last words you uttered before your memory was completely shattered were...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Correct.

The cold gleam of the shears flashes by, shattering all the mirrors at once. Everything goes back to square one, back to the unfinished battle between "Mad Shears" and the investigator on that first night.
